Can exact calibration effects describe small updates?

Apply each saved native update to Qwen3-14B and score 32 fixed answer patterns on the same 8 training calibration prompts used by the linear predictor. Predict the complete format/case/order pattern, then compare with previously measured effects on separate evaluation prompts. No evaluation prompts enter the predictor.

This functional predictor uses extra base-model and task-library access. It is not an improved LoRAcle checkpoint. All cases, negative results, controls and original thresholds are retained. Untouched generalization remains untested.
